name: Maskoff
tagline: Screens the stranger who just slid into your DMs and tells you whether to trust them
description: A cold message from an account you have never heard of is either a new contact or the opening move of a con, and the profile alone rarely says which. Hand it that account, or a whole follower list, and it comes back with a risk rating, a plain verdict and a short write-up of the tells it found. It contacts nobody.
author: RyanGBsystems
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
